121: In the possession of the one who consumed it - Since he went ahead and consumed them, and he (the original owner) comes to extract (the produce) from him, bring a proof  that (the contract) was not for three years, as we follow (award, based on) the consumption of the produce:

Do we not establish the law is in accordance with Rav Nahman in (financial) legal matters - And Rav Nahman had said the the land is established to be in the possession of the original owner, regarding one who rented a bath house for twelve gold coins per annum, one dinar per month in (chapter) 'The borrower' (above 102b) and even if the renter came (to claim) at the end of the (13th) month, he says (Rav Nahman) the full rent (i.e. 13 gold dinar) is given to the renter in a leap year:
